clue.text: Gateway to public land one must pass to enter public school

definitions.text: one must pass to enter public school

parts.note: a common is a stretch of land open to the public
a gateway is a way in, an entrance

explanation.surface: A gate into common land is somehow the hurdle a child clears before a fee-paying school.
explanation.walkthrough: The gateway to a common is its entrance. In Britain a 'public school' is a private fee-paying school, and the Common Entrance is the exam taken to get into one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Common Entrance is the British examination pupils sit for admission to independent schools.

clue.text: Manage to discern dimly

definitions.meaning: to manage or cope, as in 'how did you get on?'
to just about perceive something hard to see

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to get by somehow and to perceive something faintly.

clue.text: Ring railway to Paris airport

parts.note: a ring is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A circular rail link runs out to a French airport.
explanation.definitionFit: Orly is one of the two main airports serving Paris.

clue.text: One who gets away with a collection of caps and ties

indicators.note: a collection jumbles items together, so the letters of the two words are gathered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone escapes carrying a hoard of hats and neckwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collection of' tells you to pool the letters of CAPS and TIES and rearrange them.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapist is literally one who escapes, a person who flees reality.

clue.text: Stole in to suggest that the favourite will win the race

parts.note: to tip a horse is to suggest it will win
a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: A racing tipster sneaks in to advise that the favourite will take the race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stole' reads as a verb but is the noun, a scarf-like garment. The rest of the clue colours the tip as racing talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A tippet is a long scarf or shoulder cape, a kind of stole.

clue.text: Even so there is nothing to choose between any of them

definitions.text: there is nothing to choose between any of them
definitions.meaning: they are identical, every one alike

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means 'nevertheless' and also describes things that are identical.

clue.text: Admit swindle and surrender

parts.note: a con is a swindle
to cede is to give up or surrender territory

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to a fraud and gives themselves up.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede a point is to acknowledge or grant that it is true.

clue.text: Now is the season for giving

definitions.meaning: a time for gifts, read as a gift-time, i.e. Christmas

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the current moment, and read playfully a time for gifts.

clue.text: Tight fitting bonnet for a deadhead

definitions.text: Tight fitting bonnet for a deadhead

parts.words: Tight fitting bonnet for a deadhead
parts.note: a close-fitting cap, imagined as headwear for a skeleton's bare cranium

explanation.definitionFit: A close-fitting brimless cap is so named because it hugs the top of the head like the bone itself.

clue.text: Ruler of the waves

parts.note: suggests Britannia, but means an ocean-going ship, or punningly something that rules lines

explanation.definitionFit: A large passenger ship crosses the ocean; one who draws lines with a ruler is also one.

clue.text: A gauge to measure how tipsy people or things are?

definitions.text: A gauge to measure how tipsy people or things are?

parts.words: A gauge to measure how tipsy people or things are?
parts.note: spirit as alcohol makes it a drunkenness meter; really a tool showing whether a surface tilts

explanation.definitionFit: A builder's tool with a bubble in liquid shows whether a surface is horizontal or tilted.

clue.text: Type of billiards game football fans gamble on

definitions.meaning: a cue game played on a table with pockets
the football ..., a British betting game on match results

explanation.definitionFit: It names a cue sport and the British betting scheme on football results, the pools.

clue.text: Flabbergasted as a politician who has mislaid his notes

definitions.meaning: so astonished as to be lost for words

definitions.text: as a politician who has mislaid his notes
definitions.meaning: literally without the address he meant to deliver

explanation.definitionFit: Being dumbstruck means lacking words; a politician without notes literally has no address to give.

clue.text: Silver and crystalware in the shop window

parts.note: plate is silverware, as in the family plate
crystal tableware is fine glass

explanation.surface: Silverware and crystal are laid out on display behind a shop front.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: thick polished sheets of this material form shop windows.
explanation.definitionFit: Shop fronts are glazed with large thick polished sheets of this material.

clue.text: How vengeful Boaz might have felt had his wife been murdered

definitions.text: How vengeful Boaz might have felt had his wife been murdered

parts.words: How vengeful Boaz might have felt had his wife been murdered
parts.note: in the Bible Boaz married Ruth, so losing her would leave him without her, and merciless

explanation.definitionFit: Merciless and pitiless, and punningly a man deprived of his biblical wife.

clue.text: Like a fork-tailed gull following a ship

parts.note: as means like, in 'as a bird'
the tern is a gull-like seabird with a forked tail

explanation.surface: A seabird trails behind a vessel at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind a vessel, at or towards its back, is the nautical sense.

clue.text: Don't fidget when it's included in a retort

indicators.note: one word is put within another, so these letters sit inside the apparatus

parts.note: a still is distilling apparatus, of which a retort is one kind
taken as its letters without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A command to keep calm is placed inside a sharp reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retort' suggests a witty reply, but here it is chemical distilling apparatus.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying motionless is the opposite of fidgeting.

clue.text: Garment for those who walk tightropes without a rope

indicators.note: without tells you to take the named word away from the longer one

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Performers on the high wire wear a certain garment, though the rope itself is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Close-fitting legwear worn by dancers and acrobats is a garment.

clue.text: Tearing asunder solid rock

indicators.note: torn asunder means ripped apart, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: It is a hard igneous rock, used for building and kerbs.

clue.text: Get off your bike to see Pluto's volcano maybe

parts.note: Dis is another name for Pluto, Roman god of the underworld
a volcano is an example of a mountain, a mount

explanation.surface: A cyclist stops to look at a volcano on the dwarf planet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pluto' suggests the dwarf planet, but it is the god, also called Dis.
explanation.definitionFit: Stepping off a horse or bicycle is the usual meaning.

clue.text: Not grand but honest

definitions.meaning: a piano that is not a grand is the vertical kind
an honest person is of ... character

explanation.definitionFit: It is the vertical piano as opposed to a grand, and also means principled.

clue.text: Jug bearing a national symbol

parts.note: a flag is a national symbol
on as in bearing, carrying something on it

explanation.surface: A pitcher is decorated with a country's emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: A large vessel for wine or ale with a handle and spout is a jug.

clue.text: One who wants to convert gentiles around Virginia

definitions.text: One who wants to convert gentiles around Virginia

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed about the abbreviation
to convert something is to change its form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A missionary aims to win over non-Jews across an American state.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue describes a missionary preacher, so 'convert' looks like the religious verb, yet it is also the signal to rework the letters, and 'around' signals the wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: A preacher who seeks to win converts is a missionary of the gospel.

clue.text: Lily may cheer up a thirsty sailor…

definitions.meaning: a plant of the lily family, such as the cuckoo pint

definitions.text: may cheer up a thirsty sailor
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a shot of the navy's traditional spirit

explanation.definitionFit: It is a lily-like plant, and split in two it is a measure of naval grog.

clue.text: Down-hearted chap who should be happy with his sporting award

definitions.text: chap who should be happy with his sporting award
definitions.meaning: at Oxford and Cambridge a sportsman who represents the university wins a colour award

explanation.definitionFit: It means sad, and an Oxbridge sportsman awarded his colours is called by that name.

clue.text: … while Heather makes a rice pudding

indicators.note: a pudding is a mixed-up mass, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman named Heather cooks a sweet dish of rice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name but is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the botanical genus of heaths and heather.

clue.text: Foundation of the fast food era maybe

parts.note: a grill is a restaurant serving quick grilled food
an age is an era

explanation.surface: The basis of the burger-and-chips period of history.
explanation.definitionFit: A framework of crossing beams used as a building's foundation on soft ground.

clue.text: Confidential communication to private landlord

parts.note: personal means private
a landlord lets property, so is a letter

explanation.surface: A private note is sent to a landlord who owns his property privately.
explanation.definitionFit: A private note sent to one individual is a confidential message.
